notes.title: Update 2.0.3
notes.notes: Added in Graphics options into Settings and some fixes to side quests.

notes.title: Demo Available
notes.notes:
In preparation for Steam Next Fest we've released the demo. It's the first ~30 min of the game although there's no in game timer you'll just be gated from completing a required mission along the way.

After getting familiar with the basics, you'll get to explore a few sectors and embark on the first of many missions. [b]Your progress will carry over to the main game.[/b]

The full is is several hours long and how long will depend on the pace at which you play and how easy you find it. 

As the game is finished it's always a tough decision as a developer on what to show in a demo and how much content to essentially give away.  We're hoping this gives everyone a nice taste of the universe we built and how the game feels. Enough to entice those precious $$$ out of your wallet.

We're also using the demo as a sort of public bug test so if you notice any issues please let us know!
